note: Defects in the published usBridge 2.0 IDS (HDR, 2026-05-01). Applied when eval.usbridge.reference loads the files; the published files in source/ are not edited. Each correction replaces the whole value (propertySet) or one enumeration member (predefinedType) in the facets named by `occurrences`; the loader checks that exactly those occurrences change.
